ModMetaData.name: Jawa Scavenger Events
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
RUT_SCAVENGEREVENTS_BUILD_1. Our own IncidentWorkers for the map events Mo'Events (mlie.moevents) offered, ported behavior-not-bugs from a decompile of MoreIncidents.dll (see infrastructure/state/items/ RUT_SCAVENGEREVENTS_BUILD_1.md for the mechanism reference this was built from). Own letter text, own defNames, own baseChance settings. Scope is 7 of the original 8 mechanisms (RescueTraitor CUT by owner ruling 2026-09-11 -- its real mechanism was a half-decompiled body-horror mimicry/reveal, not a plain rescue). All 7 proven-fires live on the canonical campaign save 2026-09-29 (RUT_Migration, RUT_SurvivalPod, RUT_PodCrash, RUT_ShipBreak, RUT_Thanksgiving, RUT_Insects, RUT_Stroke); mlie.moevents RETIRED the same day -- removed from ModsConfig.xml and ModsConfig.FULL.LATEST.xml, its interim MoEventsChancesZeroed_RuledCut.xml baseChance-zeroing patch deleted as moot (the donor incidents cannot fire once the mod itself is gone).
MoreIncidents.dll ships under the MIT License (Copyright (c) 2020 Mlie, verified against the donor's own LICENSE.md/About.xml, 2026-09-25) -- permissive, no separate continuation-license restriction found. This mod's IncidentWorkers are re-authored C# (own class/field names, own guessed API signatures confirmed against Assembly-CSharp.dll) built from a read of the decompiled IL's behavior, not copied source; MIT attribution is recorded here regardless, per the license's own notice requirement.
